meta.title: Web Search
meta.description: Searches the web through the backends you enable, with each backend's price shown before you turn it on. Find it in Settings → Web Search.

title: Web Search
loadFailed: Could not load settings. Reload to try again.
saveUnconfirmed: Save could not be confirmed. Reload settings before saving again; do not assume the operation failed.
conflict: Saved configuration differs from your draft. Review the latest state before saving again.
actionFailed: The operation could not be confirmed. Search tests are never automatically replayed.
invalidField: Enter a valid value within the documented limits.
expectedRange: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
blockersTitle: This configuration will not search yet
blockNoBackends: No backend is enabled, so every search fails immediately.
blockMissingCredential: Key mode without a stored credential: {{list}}.
backendIntro: Cost groups follow the access mode you select. Modes are fixed: no automatic key choice, upgrade or fallback.
unverifiedHelp: This backend is not verified and cannot be enabled. Entering an endpoint or credential does not change that.
anonymousNoCredential: Anonymous search sends no credential and does not read a stored key.
anonymousSearchKeyedFetch: Anonymous search sends no credential. The keyed fetch mode on the Page fetch tab uses the key entered here.
credentialForFetch: Used by this provider's keyed fetch mode; the current search mode does not read it.
deleteCredentialConfirm: Delete this saved credential? This cannot be undone.
credentialFailed: The credential change could not be confirmed. The input was cleared; check the saved state before retrying.
testHelp: Save first; each test sends one real request with saved settings and may cost money.
testNeedsBackend: Save an enabled backend first; tests only use saved configuration.
diagnosticsHelp: Recent request outcomes. Clearing diagnostics does not reset daily attempt budgets.
transferHelp: Export leaves out secrets and strips query strings from endpoints. Review an import before saving it.
imported: Imported into the draft. Review and save to apply.
importFailed: Invalid JSON. Your current draft was kept.
defaultsConfirm: Replace your draft with defaults? Nothing is saved until you choose Save.
defaultsRestored: Defaults loaded into the draft. Save to apply.
help.maxResults: Maximum merged sources returned to the caller.
help.overallTimeoutMs: Deadline for the entire search, including retries.
help.language: Choose from the fixed list. A backend that supports the language receives it in its own format.
help.region: Choose from the fixed list of two-letter regions. Only backends that support a region receive it.
help.recency: Applied where supported by the selected API.
help.safeSearch: Request safer results where the backend supports it.
help.includeDomains: Comma-separated domains; leave empty for no allowlist.
help.dedup: Merge duplicates by normalized URL, or URL and title.
help.fusion: Combine ranking by reciprocal rank or preserve backend order.
help.retry.enabled: Configured HTTP retries can incur repeated charges. This page never replays a test action automatically.
help.retry.statuses: Only these response codes are retried, on the same backend and access mode.
help.retry.maxRetries: Additional attempts after the initial request.
help.retry.networkErrors: A failed response may still have incurred usage.
help.retry.timeouts: A timed-out request may still have incurred usage.
help.breaker.enabled: Temporarily pause a backend after repeated failures.
help.breaker.threshold: Failures required to open the circuit.
help.breaker.cooldownMs: Time before a backend can be attempted again.
help.cache.enabled: Reuse matching search results within the configured lifetime.
help.diagnostics.maxEntries: Limit the number of retained diagnostic records.
help.backend.enabled: Only explicitly enabled, verified backends can execute searches.
help.backend.mode: Choose a fixed anonymous or key mode. No automatic switching.
help.backend.endpoint: Use a trusted HTTPS endpoint, or a trusted local self-hosted endpoint. Never put secrets in the URL.
help.backend.rateLimitPerMinute: Local attempt guard, not a provider billing guarantee.
help.backend.dailyAttemptLimit: Local daily attempt budget; retries also consume attempts.
testQueryPlaceholder: What should this backend look for?
activeTitle: This plugin is not the active search provider
activeOther: The web seam currently selects “{{provider}}”. Searches keep going there until this plugin is selected.
activateSelf: Use this plugin for web search
fetchProviderSelectionHelp: Only the selected provider is used. Configure the others below; pick one before enabling this route.
colorLegend: Green: free, own account or self-hosted. Yellow: free allowance. Red: trial or paid. Cheapest first.
credentialPending: Wait for the current action to finish.
credentialReadOnly: This credential is provided by another source and cannot be changed here.
help.tools.webSearchPlus: Off hides the tool entirely: the agent then searches only through the configured strategy.
help.tools.compactByDefault: Sources carry only URL, title and date, which saves context. A call can still ask for full snippets.
help.browser.endpoint: Address of the shared browser, such as ws://<host>:3000/ws. It overrides a backend's own endpoint when set.
help.browser.statePath: Optional. Where the browser container writes the signed-in session; empty uses the search core default.
help.browser.timeoutMs: How long one browser read may take.
help.browser.maxConcurrentReads: How many browser reads run at once on one site. Unlike “Parallel concurrency”, it does not limit search requests.
help.browser.maxPooledTabs: Search tabs kept open so a later note read can click a listed card. Default 4, range 1–8; read limits stay the same.
sharedBrowserHint: Settings for the browser you host: endpoint, token, session file and read limits. Every browser-mode backend uses it.
browserTokenHelp: Used to connect to the browser service. Sign in to Xiaohongshu through VNC.
browserInheritedEndpoint: This backend inherits the shared endpoint: {{endpoint}}
browserInheritedEndpointMissing: This backend has no endpoint: the shared browser settings are empty and it has none of its own.
browserOwnEndpoint: The shared browser endpoint is empty, so this backend uses its own endpoint: {{endpoint}}.
browserInheritedHint: The endpoint and the token both come from the shared browser settings, so they are changed in one place.
browserOverride: Give this backend its own endpoint (fallback only)
browserOverrideHint: Applies only while the shared browser settings are empty. Use it to point one backend at a different browser.
help.tools.webExtract: Off hides the tool, so an agent with its own fetch tool does not get a duplicate. Fetch settings stay available.
help.pageFetch.overallTimeoutMs: Limits the whole fetch, including fallback. When it expires, the fetch stops instead of trying another route.
help.pageFetch.maxRedirects: Redirects are followed one hop at a time and every hop is re-checked against the target policy.
help.pageFetch.maxBodyBytes: A download limit, not an output cutoff: above it the fetch stops and no partial page is returned.
help.pageFetch.maxOutputChars: The returned page is truncated at this length and the result says so.
help.pageFetch.maxRuleScanChars: Fallback rules read at most this many characters of one field; the result says when a field was cut.
help.pageFetch.allowPrivateNetworks: Off by default. When off, local names and private addresses are refused before any connection is made.
help.pageFetch.browser.context: Isolated starts without saved site login. Session loads the state file, with the privacy effects of that account.
help.pageFetch.browser.settleMs: An optional bounded wait after DOMContentLoaded. There is no unbounded network-idle wait.
help.pageFetch.browser.selectorWait: Optional. When it does not appear before the route times out, the captured page may be incomplete.
help.pageFetch.browser.challengeSolver: Auto tries once on a Cloudflare challenge and never waits for a person. Off returns the page as it is.
challengeSolver.off: Off (leave a challenge page as it answered)
challengeSolver.auto: Auto (one bounded attempt, no human wait)
fetchToolHelp: web_extract returns one page as Markdown or HTML. The format is required, and page content is always untrusted.
fetchReady: The saved fetch chain can run.
fetchReadyHelp: Checked from configuration and stored credentials only; nothing is fetched and no provider is called.
problem.fetchNoRoutes: No route is enabled, so every page fetch fails.
problem.fetchBrowserNoEndpoint: The browser route is enabled but no shared browser endpoint is set.
problem.fetchProviderMissing: The provider route is enabled but no fetch-capable provider is selected.
problem.fetchProviderCredential: {{provider}} needs a stored credential for its saved fetch access mode.
fetchRoutesHelp: Routes run one at a time in this order. A disabled route is skipped; a matching fallback rule moves on to the next.
fetchRouteHelp.browser: Rendered DOM from the shared browser.
fetchRouteHelp.provider: One selected provider, either native Markdown or the page HTML that provider itself returns.
fetchTimeoutHelp: This route gives up after this long; a timeout rule can then fall back to the next route.
fetchRulesHelp: Rules are OR, conditions inside one are AND. Missing fields are unavailable. Markdown conditions need Markdown output.
fetchPresetsHelp: Presets are editable rules. The challenge preset checks a title and an HTML marker; it does not solve a challenge.
fetchProviderHelp: Choosing a provider does not change whether it takes part in search, and sends no request on its own.
fetchProviderMarkdownOnly: This provider returns Markdown or plain text, not page HTML. An HTML request skips it and moves to the next route.
fetchModeCostsHelp: Each fetch mode states its cost and quota, so the price is known before the mode is enabled. Keyless modes spend no credit; keyed modes use the stored key.
fetchModeDocumentedOnly: This mode follows the provider's API documentation, but no call with a real API key was made. Treat it as documented, not live-verified.
fetchModeHelp: Only fetch modes the provider supports can be selected. Fetching may use a different mode and endpoint than searching.
fetchEndpointHelp: Deliberately separate from the search endpoint. An existing search URL is never rewritten into a fetch URL.
fetchProviderTimeoutHelp: Bound on one provider call, capped by the route timeout.
fetchCredentialShared: A keyed fetch mode shares the saved search key. Enter it here or on the Search tab; it is never displayed.
fetchCredentialHelp: One stored key, shared with this provider's search card. Saved credentials are never displayed.
fetchTestHelp: A user-triggered test on saved settings. It reaches the network and may be billed; nothing runs automatically.
matchField.title: title
credentialNotRequired: No credential needed for this mode
fetchProviderFields: Rules that read title, status or HTML stay unavailable on a provider that does not return them.
browserConnectionNotLogin: A successful connection only proves the endpoint and token work; it does not mean a site is signed in.
browserDependentsHelp: Every enabled feature below uses this shared browser. Disable them all to save without a connection check.
browserDependencyOwn: Uses its own endpoint while the shared one is empty: {{endpoint}}
browserNoDependents: Nothing enabled currently uses the shared browser.
browserCheckOk: Connected to {{endpoint}} in {{duration}} ms: an isolated context was created and closed.
browserCheckSavedNotRequired: Saving only checks this endpoint while a browser-dependent feature is enabled.
browserCheckStale: The endpoint or token changed since this check; check again before trusting it.
routeBrowserEndpointMissing: No shared browser endpoint, so this route cannot attach.
routeProviderMissing: No fetch-capable provider is selected for this route.
fetchProviderNoneHelp: The provider route is skipped; no provider is called.
fetchSearchCapsNote: These are fetch settings. They do not change this provider's search settings, and search limits do not bound a fetch.
savedVerified: Settings saved; the enabled browser endpoint passed the bounded connection check.
saveRejected: Save rejected. Review the listed problems; the draft keeps every edit.
browserVerificationFailed: Save blocked: an enabled browser endpoint did not verify. Nothing was written and the draft is unchanged.
saveFailed: The server reported a write failure and the saved settings differ from your draft. Your draft is kept; reload first.
connectionVerified: Browser connection verified. This is the endpoint connection, not a site login.
connectionFailed: The browser connection check failed. The saved configuration was untouched.
connectionCheckFailed: The connection check could not run. The saved configuration was untouched.
issue.config.notObject: The saved value is not a configuration object.
issue.field.httpStatus: Use HTTP error status codes from {{min}} to {{max}}.
issue.field.domain: Use domain names without scheme, path, or wildcards.
issue.field.range: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
issue.field.endpoint: Use an HTTP(S) or WS(S) endpoint without credentials, query, or fragment.
issue.retry.delay.order: The maximum delay must not be shorter than the initial delay.
issue.backend.mode.unsupported: {{backendLabel}} does not support this access mode. Choose {{allowed}}.
issue.backend.unverified: {{backendLabel}} has no verified protocol and cannot be enabled.
issue.backend.endpoint.invalid: {{backendLabel}} needs an HTTP(S) endpoint without credentials, query, or fragment.
issue.backend.option.range: {{backendLabel}} option {{option}}: enter a number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
issue.backend.fetch.mode.unsupported: {{providerLabel}} does not fetch in {{mode}} mode. Choose {{allowed}}.
issue.backend.fetch.endpoint.invalid: {{backendLabel}} needs an HTTP(S) fetch endpoint without credentials or fragment.
issue.backend.fetch.option.range: {{backendLabel}} fetch option {{option}}: enter a number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
issue.backend.fetch.option.type: {{backendLabel}} fetch option {{option}} must be true or false.
issue.backend.fetch.endpoint.notSupporte: {{backendLabel}} has no verified fetch operation, so it cannot have a fetch endpoint.
issue.pageFetch.routes.type: Page fetch needs its three route records.
issue.pageFetch.routes.records: Each route must be an object with kind, enabled, timeout and rules.
issue.pageFetch.routes.kinds: Hold exactly one record of each route: HTTP, browser and provider.
issue.pageFetch.routes.none: At least one route must stay enabled, otherwise every fetch fails.
issue.pageFetch.route.browserEndpointMis: The {{kindLabel}} route needs a shared browser endpoint in the Browser tab before it can be enabled.
issue.pageFetch.providerId.notFetchCapab: {{providerLabel}} has no verified page-fetch operation in this release.
issue.pageFetch.providerId.required: The provider route needs a fetch-capable provider.
issue.rule.list: Fallback rules must be a list.
issue.rule.tooMany: At most {{max}} fallback rules are allowed per route.
issue.rule.object: Each fallback rule must be an object.
issue.rule.id.format: Use 1–{{max}} letters, digits, hyphens or underscores as the rule id.
issue.rule.id.duplicate: Rule ids must be unique within one route.
issue.rule.enabled.type: Rule enabled must be true or false.
issue.rule.conditions.missing: A rule needs at least one condition.
issue.rule.conditions.tooMany: At most {{max}} conditions are allowed per rule.
issue.condition.object: Each condition must be an object.
issue.condition.statuses.missing: A status condition needs at least one HTTP status code.
issue.condition.statuses.tooMany: At most {{max}} status codes are allowed.
issue.condition.statuses.range: Use integer HTTP status codes from {{min}} to {{max}}.
issue.condition.apiStatus.route: A provider API status condition is only valid on the provider route.
issue.condition.kinds.missing: An error condition needs at least one failure kind.
issue.condition.kinds.tooMany: Too many failure kinds are selected.
issue.condition.match.caseSensitive: Case sensitivity must be true or false.
issue.condition.match.value: Enter a non-empty value to match.
issue.condition.match.regexTooLong: A regular expression is limited to {{max}} characters.
issue.condition.match.regexUnsupported: This regular expression is unsupported; lookaround, backreferences and flags are not allowed.
issue.browser.endpoint.missing: No browser endpoint is configured for an enabled browser-dependent feature.
issue.browser.endpoint.invalid: Use a WS(S) Playwright endpoint without credentials, query, or fragment.
issue.browser.authRejected: The browser endpoint rejected the stored token. Save the token the container printed, then check the connection again.
issue.browser.unreachable: No browser server answered at {{endpoint}}. Start the browser container and check the address.
issue.browser.protocolMismatch: The browser server and this client disagree on protocol version; both sides must share the same major.minor.
issue.browser.connectFailed: Could not attach to {{endpoint}}. Check the endpoint and the browser container log.
issue.browser.timeout: The browser did not answer within the bounded save check. Check the container, then save again.
issue.browser.contextFailed: The browser accepted the connection but could not create an isolated context. Check the container log.
browserCheckSavedVerified: The endpoint and stored token were verified when this configuration was saved.
saveStateUnknown: The save result could not be confirmed. Reload settings before saving again; do not assume it was applied or rejected.
saveCancelled: The save was cancelled before it was written. Your draft is unchanged.
conflictTitle: Saved state differs from this draft
